VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people

VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple releases technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, enhancing user experience and developer opportunities.

VR.summary: Valve's Steam Frame standalone headset nears launch as a new store page highlights upcoming content, though pricing and release date remain undisclosed.

VR.summary: FitXR introduces 'Journey', a personalized workout recommendation system for Quest users, enhancing fitness engagement and accessibility.
